name: print-social-blue-voucher-new-month-post-with-torn-fold
title: Bright blue 'Happy New Month' post with a voucher card sliding from a folded flap
whatItIs: A textured royal-blue post with a brand name at the top, 'Happy New Month' and a welcome line, a cream voucher with '01 08' numerals and a gift icon peeking from a folded blue flap, and a white footer bar with URL and handles.
whatItMeans: Warm and celebratory; the flap suggests a gift being opened.
techniques: Slide a voucher out of a folded flap.
Use big numerals for the date.
Keep colours to blue, white and cream.

vocabulary.definition: A card offering a gift or discount.
A folded shape hiding part of an object.
A white strip with contact info.
